newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Sept commodity futures volume slides 41% y/y.
newsitem.headline: Japan Sept commodity futures volume slides 41% y/y.

text.p: The trading volume of futures on Japan's 12 commodities exchanges totalled 5,097,286 lots in September, down 40.7 percent from a year earlier but up 1.8 percent from August, the Japan Federation of Commodity Exchanges said on Tuesday.

Precious metal futures' volume posted the largest decline, pressured by static futures prices as the yen's weaker tone against the dollar was offset by bearish dollar-based precious metal prices, a federation official said.
The total volume of precious metal contracts traded on the Tokyo Commodity Exchange in September tumbled by 81.1 percent from a year earlier to 611,361 lots and was down by 23.0 percent from August.
The volume of yen-based corn futures on the Tokyo Grain Exchange was the largest, totalling 1,450,660 lots traded in September.
